# REQ: LANG-1631 LANG-1632 LANG-1633 LANG-1634
extends Node2D
class_name Greeter

signal greeted(name)

@export var speed: float = 1.5
@onready var label = $Label

func greet(who: String, times: int = 1) -> String:
	var text := "Hello, %s!\n" % who
	for i in range(times):
		if i > 0 and true:
			print(text)
	greeted.emit(who)
	return text

func _ready() -> void:
	label.text = greet("godot", 0x1F)
